This week, shares have slipped after the U.S. Department of Transportation ordered Delta and Aeromexico to dismantle their nearly decade-long joint venture. The antitrust-driven move immediately casts a new layer of uncertainty over Delta’s cross-border strategy, challenging the company's ability to defend its turf in the vital U.S.-Mexico route network. content.title: American Express Platinum Card gets pricier and adds new perks, including a $400 dining credit
content.summary: The Platinum Card is getting shinier and pricier.  American Express' latest update to its high-end Platinum Card, unveiled Thursday, comes with a lot more perks, including a $400 credit for dining out, and a lofty annual fee of $895.  The Platinum Card refresh is just the latest from the major credit card issuers, and the higher fees may put pressure on some cardholders to choose between the Platinum Card or another high-fee card like Chase’s Sapphire Reserve Card.
